## Plugin reference

- Description: Umbrella for music shared across apps: the chord box (a chord's degree colour, numeral and tile), the ambient engine (generative WebAudio music and sound effects), and the background music service (the music apps offer, played from the page root so it outlives the app, one at a time across the browser's tabs, with the action bar's music button).
- Sub-plugins:
  - **`ambient`** — Generative ambient music in WebAudio, no samples: createAmbient(ctx, { mood }) plays a mood (lofi — a swung 72 bpm Rhodes loop with drums and vinyl crackle; bossa — an 84 bpm nylon guitar over…
  - **`background`** — The background music service: apps offer music as BackgroundMusic.Source contributions (an app, a kind, useTitle, and usePlayer — run from the page root, so the music outlives the app's views; a…
  - **`chord-box`** — The chord box: <ChordBox> (a frame painted in the colour of its numeral's number — filled tile, given or empty — holding its numeral and name, with a full-bleed hit button behind the content and now…
